notes: No «ح» here: the two isnads are separate groups, each repeating its own names
The first isnad ends at «الأعمش» with no saying of its own; the second isnad carries the saying, which both groups share (rule 4)
«الأعمش» stands twice in the text; the occurrence marks each group's own name
«رضى الله عنها» is a blessing and is left out
